title: Infernal Railway Sorceress
description: A fierce woman with vibrant pink and magenta flowing hair stands in the foreground wearing a dark corset, red skirt, fishnet stockings, and boots. She holds a chain and key while posing beside a large circular metal portal that reveals a surreal night scene with a glowing purple train, spiral staircase, castle on a cliff, and lava flows.
prompt: A dramatic dark fantasy scene featuring a powerful sorceress with long flowing bright pink hair and a crown, wearing a black off-shoulder corset, red skirt, fishnet stockings and heavy boots. She stands beside a large circular riveted metal portal frame, holding a chain and key. Inside the portal is a surreal landscape with a glowing purple train on tracks, a spiral staircase, torches, and a dark castle on a cliff under a fiery sky. Lava flows across the ground with dripping paint effects, vibrant colors, dynamic composition.
